key_insight: Amplifying constraint-aligned signals already present in trained denoisers improves candidate rankings before greedy decoding.
engineering_relevance: PISG offers a training-free inference enhancement for diffusion-based routing and graph optimization solvers without requiring downstream refinement.
method: Construct a structure-degraded prediction at each denoising step.
Extrapolate the unperturbed prediction away from the degraded prediction.
Apply constrained greedy decoding to the guided scores.
evidence_signal: Without downstream refinement, PISG improves all 16 tested TSP solver-scale pairs and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to 4.8%.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify inference overhead, and gains after 2-opt persist in most—not all—large-scale settings.
paper_title: PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
